title: Widen further: ASPECT_RATIO 96->128
description: Increased ASPECT_RATIO from 96 to 128 (n_embd 768->1024, n_head 6->8), and reduced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 to avoid OOM at the larger width (grad_accum_steps auto-doubled to keep TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE fixed).
reflection: val_bpb 1.042954, worse than the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (0.998671) and even worse than the original ASPECT_RATIO=64 baseline (1.014027). The width trend does NOT continue monotonically -- 96 is better than 64, but 128 is worse than both. Likely two compounding costs: (1) the forced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE halving (needed to avoid OOM) hurt step throughput within the fixed 5-min budget, and (2) the model may simply be past its capacity sweet spot for this token budget at ASPECT_RATIO=128. This brackets the width optimum: somewhere between 96 and 128, likely closer to 96. Also note I deliberately skipped the width+batchsize-stack experiment that 5 other agents (a1-a5) all proposed identically this round, since running a 6th copy would add no new information -- better to spend my slot exploring an untested region.
